method.readyDefinition: Navigation plus full load; concept gallery waits for 14 plot SVG elements and two animation frames; other chart routes wait for mounted canvases and two frames; docs use load plus two frames, not an interactivity assertion
method.limitation: Single direct timing sample per route, no field INP. Three mobile Lighthouse runs for bar and possibilities; other Lighthouse entries are single runs. Live network measurements are variable and route timings cannot be ranked as controlled comparisons. Lighthouse metrics are simulated, not the directly throttled readiness results. The first four public timings were collected while a public Lighthouse probe was also in flight; that can increase contention. An independent final Chart possibilities probe, with no other audit load running, is recorded separately.
